This does not reassess all due-actuality or unrestricted goodness claims, original jurisdiction, or the complete worldviews. current_assessment.assessment: Independence of a standard from whichever verdict is produced does not establish an ontically external standard. A positive intrinsic proposal treats one productive actuality as essentially recipient-perfecting, with genuine rational fulfillment and jointly required relations, rather than making whatever occurs good. Local due perfection alone does not supply original productive finality: the actual exercise must manifest that positive nature. The external-standard objection succeeds conditionally with an independent standard, a real constitutive or explanatory dependence, and an inclusive source-sufficiency claim excluding it; that dependence has not been established for the strongest intrinsic rival. A personal constitution has a distinctive account of apprehended practical specification, but cognition alone neither makes the object good nor proves its actual guidance. The executed pair-count correction excludes output-indexed correctness and leaves both stronger constitutions available for further assessment. No full ultimate realization, global explanatory equivalence, strongest-rival defeat or premise discharge is claimed. The due/unrestricted bridge retains AllActualitiesDue; ActualRoot retains its actual-concrete relation-relative scope. The follow-up gives a substantive conditional failure of A-to-R-to-D-to-A grounding when the same facts inhabit one justified transitive irreflexive order. A-to-R-to-D-to-Beneficial(A) is not that cycle; direction toward a possible recipient good need not receive its specification from an actual downstream token norm. The factorization application tests exact completeness for each fixed eligibility fact, not intrinsic rulehood, actual selection or ultimacy alone. The consent case defeats a consent-omitting projection under retained standing premises, not the source; no actual varying-norm witness against the strongest intrinsic account was obtained. Positive unity must realize the cognitive and normative bases jointly. Warranted full pure-wisdom and recognition bundles would exclude noncognition, but generic possession, recipient cognition and knowledge of actual effects do not establish the possible-exemplar or operative-direction application.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix one actual source and one shared positive source profile for the two recipient goods: truth-directed uptake and original directed standing. Substantiate its own disposition to the good of possible recipients and its actual productive exercise, or identify an indispensable independent supplier. For the cycle exclusion, establish the return-dependence of the same actual exercise and a justified common strict order; appraisal alone is insufficient. For the completeness exclusion, defend the complete-data claim and genuinely admitted profiles before showing a same-option eligibility difference; variation under one conditional rule is insufficient. Apply existing whole-power/pure-wisdom and cognitive-recognition bundles only with all premises at the same n, and separately warrant possible-exemplar coverage and practical uptake. Do not rerun the completed finite counts as substitutes for these application tests.
